exec.purpose: Read your kubectl context and pod status
allowedArgs: go-template=[{{range $i, $p := .items}}{{if $i}},{{end}}{{$ready := true}}{{$restarts := 0.0}}{{$reason := ""}}{{if not .status.containerStatuses}}{{$ready = false}}{{end}}{{range .status.containerStatuses}}{{if not .ready}}{{$ready = false}}{{end}}{{if gt .restartCount $restarts}}{{$restarts = .restartCount}}{{end}}{{if .state.waiting}}{{$reason = or .state.waiting.reason "Waiting"}}{{end}}{{end}}{"name":{{printf "%q" .metadata.name}},"ns":{{printf "%q" .metadata.namespace}},"phase":{{printf "%q" (or .status.phase "Unknown")}},"terminating":{{if .metadata.deletionTimestamp}}true{{else}}false{{end}},"ready":{{$ready}},"restarts":{{$restarts}},"reason":{{printf "%q" $reason}},"node":{{printf "%q" (or .spec.nodeName "")}},"created":{{printf "%q" .metadata.creationTimestamp}}}{{end}}]

go-template=[{{range $i, $p := .items}}{{if $i}},{{end}}{{$ready := true}}{{$restarts := 0.0}}{{$reason := ""}}{{if not .status.containerStatuses}}{{$ready = false}}{{end}}{{range .status.containerStatuses}}{{if not .ready}}{{$ready = false}}{{end}}{{if gt .restartCount $restarts}}{{$restarts = .restartCount}}{{end}}{{if .state.waiting}}{{$reason = or .state.waiting.reason "Waiting"}}{{end}}{{end}}{"name":{{printf "%q" .metadata.name}},"ns":{{printf "%q" .metadata.namespace}},"phase":{{printf "%q" (or .status.phase "Unknown")}},"terminating":{{if .metadata.deletionTimestamp}}true{{else}}false{{end}},"ready":{{$ready}},"restarts":{{$restarts}},"reason":{{printf "%q" $reason}},"node":{{printf "%q" (or .spec.nodeName "")}},"created":{{printf "%q" .metadata.creationTimestamp}}}{{end}}]

settings.title: Notify when older pods are not ready

ko.Read your kubectl context and pod status: kubectl로 현재 컨텍스트와 파드 상태 읽기
ko.The credentials in your kubeconfig expir: kubeconfig의 자격 증명이 만료되었습니다. exec 플러그인이 새로 로그인해야 합니다. 터미널에서 명령을 실행한 뒤 다시 시도하세요.
ko.Install kubectl (Homebrew: brew install: kubectl을 설치한 뒤(Homebrew: brew install kubectl) 다시 시도하세요.
ko.The cluster status comes back when this: Mac이 다시 온라인이 되면 클러스터 상태가 돌아옵니다.
ko.It may be busy or behind a VPN that isn’: 바쁘거나, 연결되지 않은 VPN 뒤에 있을 수 있습니다.
ko.Is it running, and is this the right con: 클러스터가 실행 중이고 컨텍스트가 맞는지 확인하세요. 위젯 설정에서 지정할 수 있습니다.
